user.title: Step 1 / 4 – Devices & Sensors
user.description: Select the TRVs and sensors for this heating zone. Calibration entities and quirk switches are detected automatically.

data.name: Zone name (e.g. Living Room)
data.window_open_delay: Heating off – delay after window opens
data.window_close_delay: Heating on – delay after window closes
data.no_off_fallback: When window open: set TRVs to 5°C instead of leaving at last value

schedule.title: Step 2 / 4 – Temperatures & Schedule
schedule.description:
Daily flow: Night → Comfort → Night

When all persons are away, ThermoSmart automatically switches to the away temperature – regardless of the schedule.

data.away_temp: Away temperature (automatically when everyone is gone)
data.vacation_temp: Vacation temperature (frost protection when home is empty for extended period)
data.eco_temp: Eco temperature (energy saving, between night and comfort)
data.temp_tolerance: Temperature tolerance – only control TRV beyond this offset

data_description.sched_wd_morning: Comfort temperature should be reached by this time – ThermoSmart preheats automatically in advance
data_description.sched_wd_night: Night temperature applies from this time
data_description.sched_we_morning: Comfort temperature should be reached by this time – ThermoSmart preheats automatically in advance
data_description.sched_we_night: Night temperature applies from this time

presence.title: Step 3 / 4 – Presence & Automation
presence.description: Who is home? ThermoSmart automatically switches to away mode when everyone leaves.

data_description.vacation_boolean: Any entity that goes 'on' when vacation is active (input_boolean, binary_sensor, calendar …). Can be left empty.
data_description.learning_enabled: ThermoSmart learns heating rates, cooling rates and optimal temperatures for this zone.

weather.title: Step 4 / 4 – Weather & Outdoor Sensors
weather.description: All fields optional – own sensors take priority over the weather entity.

data_description.weather_entity: Used for forecasts and forecast suppression. Leave empty if using only own sensors.
data_description.outdoor_temp_sensor: Own sensors are more accurate than the weather entity and are preferred.

error.entity_not_found: Weather entity not found. Please select a valid entity or leave the field empty.
error.required: At least one thermostat / TRV is required.
